name: Let Him Cook
subject: A winged-helmeted classical Hermes culinary master standing atop a broad stepped acanthus-carved chrome trophy pedestal behind a Greek-key-engraved cauldron, stirring a long ladle with one hand and commanding a rising vortex of swirling chrome flame ribbons and clockwork gears from inside the cauldron's open rim.

name: Autonomous Avalanche
subject: A monumental neoclassical silver-chrome trophy sculpture of Mount Olympus unleashing a sweeping S-curved tidal avalanche of sculpted chrome snow-curls, crystalline slabs and iconic tools from a winged Hermes summit figure onto a wide stepped acanthus-carved chrome pedestal.

name: Toolchain Maxxer
subject: A peacock-tail fan of a dozen distinct chrome tools, including wrench, saw, calipers, chisel, pliers and compass, spread in a perfect radiating semicircle around one central hub.

name: Full Send
subject: A polished chrome rocket shaped like a classical amphora blasting upward from a Doric column base, trailing three braided plumes that end in a gear, a folded page and a small globe.

name: Subagent Commander
subject: A chrome general's bust in a crested Corinthian helmet, ringed by a disciplined formation of small identical winged messenger statuettes hovering in a circle around its shoulders.

name: Background Process Enjoyer
subject: A glass-domed chrome gear train whirring away, with a tiny reclining classical figure lounging on the largest cog and sipping from a goblet while the machinery turns around it.

name: Cron Necromancer
subject: An upright chrome hourglass on a fluted chrome column with a stepped round plinth, a small skeletal chrome hand gripping its waist, a glowing periwinkle sand stream, and violet-white lightning branching from the hourglass down the column.

name: Red Text Connoisseur
subject: A wide chrome wine-tasting cup brimming with a swirl of jagged etched error-bolts, held under a tilted nose-shaped funnel, a cobalt halftone glow rising off the liquid.

name: Stack Trace Sommelier
subject: A chrome sommelier's decanter pouring a long cascade of flat, stepped, folded ribbons down in a staircase pattern into a tasting cup, each ribbon step etched with fine hairlines.

name: Actually Read The Logs
subject: A chrome open book on a lectern, its blank ruled pages lit by a single lantern beam, with a large magnifying lens hovering over them as hairlines trace across the pages.

name: Port 3000 Is Taken
subject: A veiled classical wall socket half draped in a chrome shroud, with a stern stone-carved bust of a stubborn figure jammed into the socket and refusing to leave.

name: Permission Denied Any%
subject: A veiled chrome sprinter frozen mid-stride just before slamming into a towering draped wall, a single stop-hand carved in relief on the cloth-covered face of the wall.

name: Dependency Hell Tourist
subject: A small chrome traveler in a wide sunhat peering through binoculars from the top of a precarious tower of tangled cubes and snapping chain links, flames licking at the base.

name: The Fix Was Restarting It
subject: A chrome circular arrow wrapped around a classical power-button ring, its open gap glowing as the arrow bites its own tail like an ouroboros, sparks scattering from the join.

name: Forgot The Env Var
subject: A veiled chrome key hovering just out of reach above a cloth-covered lock, half of its bow evaporating into dithered grain as if it were forgotten mid-thought.

name: YAML Colon Incident
subject: A shrouded chrome parchment scroll of tidy, indented hairline rungs that has snapped apart in the middle where two heavy stacked spheres have plunged straight through it.

name: Docker Name Collision
subject: Two identical chrome shipping containers wedged into the same dock slot, one shrouded under a draped tarp, their corrugated ribs grinding together and throwing a spray of sparks.

name: This Was Supposed To Be Quick
subject: A small chrome hiker in winged sandals stepping off a short garden path onto an immense winding mountain trail that spirals up and around a towering peak and out of sight.

name: One More Small Change
subject: A teetering chrome spire of stacked pages and leaning scaffolding, with a single feather quill stuck into the top and one more small quill hovering above it, about to add to the stack.

name: Vibe Architect
subject: A chrome architect's drafting compass sweeping a vast glowing circle around a cluster of floating temple fragments, arches, domes and columns assembling themselves in midair.

name: Pixel Goblin
subject: A chrome goblin gargoyle crouched over a canvas made of coarse square pixels, painting with a tiny brush, the tiles dissolving into cobalt halftone grain at its edges.

name: Ship First, Ask Later
subject: A chrome galleon already halfway down the slipway under full sail, with a lone hooded figure on the dock reaching out too late with one outstretched hand.

name: CSS Exorcist
subject: A hooded chrome priest holding a paintbrush upright like an exorcist's cross, driving out a writhing demon made of tangled flowing ribbons that unspool upward in etched spirals.

name: One Character Fix
subject: A shrouded chrome pair of watchmaker's tweezers placing one tiny jewel into a wrecked and smoking mechanism, the whole ruin half covered by a cloth being lifted away.

name: Skillsmith
subject: A classical chrome hammer and tongs crossed over a glowing hexagonal gem on an anvil, sparks scattering outward as fine hairline rays that fan across the whole frame.

name: Skill Issue? Skill Created.
subject: A newly forged chrome sword with a winged crossguard planted point-down in an anvil, a cracked and discarded practice shield slumped at its base.

name: Memory Keeper
subject: A faceted chrome crystal cradled inside an open ornate reliquary box, hairline beams radiating from the crystal's heart as if the gem were quietly remembering.

name: Memory Palace
subject: A miniature chrome neoclassical temple with a grand colonnade and dome, its facade cut open to reveal tiny lit rooms, with a laurel wreath crowning the pediment.

name: Context Dragon
subject: A chrome dragon curled atop a hoard of towering stacked tablets, its belly bulging, one claw clutching a swollen moon-sized pearl that strains under pressure with hairline cracks.

name: Gateway Dweller
subject: A chrome triumphal archway lived in like a home, with a tiny figure resting in an armchair inside it, a globe lamp overhead and signal arcs radiating from the keystone.

name: Plugin Goblin
subject: A grinning chrome goblin hugging a jigsaw puzzle piece bigger than its head and cramming it into an empty socket in its own chest, tiny sockets dotting its limbs.

name: Rollback Wizard
subject: A veiled chrome hourglass with a half-lifted cloth, its sand flowing upward from the lower bulb into the upper one in a frozen rising stream, a wizard's pointed hat resting on top.

name: Rabbit Hole Certified
subject: A chrome rabbit tumbling headfirst into a spiraling tunnel of concentric rings, one ear trailing behind and a round medal of merit swinging from its neck.

name: Citation Goblin
subject: A tiny chrome goblin librarian perched on a teetering pile of scrolls, a pair of spectacles on its nose, stamping the topmost page while a thread of pages unspools beside it.

name: Docs Archaeologist

name: Browser Possession
subject: A chrome marionette control cross with taut strings pulling a large mouse-cursor arrow like a puppet, an eerie spectral halo hovering above the cross.

name: Terminal Goblin
subject: A chrome goblin gargoyle hunched on top of an old boxy CRT monitor, hammering at a mechanical keyboard with claws, a solid glowing cursor block reflected in its eyes.

name: Patch Wizard
subject: A chrome wizard's hand wielding a needle and thread to stitch a star-shaped patch over a torn, jagged rift in a flat sheet of cloth, the stitches glowing with periwinkle light.

name: File Archaeologist
subject: A chrome filing cabinet half buried in desert sand, one drawer pulled open and a single folder lifted into the light, a brush and trowel resting on its top.

name: Image Whisperer
subject: A large chrome human eye with a camera-aperture iris, a whispered curl of etched hairlines flowing into it from one side like breath, its lashes fine as engraved rays.

name: Voice Of The Machine
subject: A chrome classical theatre mask with a speaker-grille mouth, concentric sound-wave rings radiating outward from it like etched hairlines.

name: Model Hopper
subject: A chrome frog caught mid-leap between floating lily pads, each pad a different faceted geometric shape, ripples spreading beneath as concentric hairlines.

name: OpenRouter Enjoyer
subject: A chrome multi-lane roundabout seen from above, a central hub with eight winding roads radiating outward and a tiny winged messenger zipping along one lane.

name: Codex Conjurer
subject: A chrome cauldron overflowing with a spiral of glowing vapor that curls up into a swirl of sparks, a conjurer's wand dipping into the brew.

name: Multi-Model Mage
subject: A tall chrome wizard hat orbited by a swirl of small floating crystal gems, each cut in a different shape, circling its brim like tiny moons.

name: Five-Model Flight
subject: A flight of five chrome birds, each a different species silhouette, wheeling through the sky in a tight V formation with radiating hairlines streaming behind them.

name: Provider Polyglot
subject: A chrome parrot perched on an armillary sphere, its tail feathers fanned into several distinct patterned plumes, beak open mid-song.

name: Model Sommelier
subject: A chrome tasting flight board holding five small stemmed glasses of graduating sizes, each cradling a different glowing faceted gem in place of wine.

name: Claude Confidant
subject: Two chrome classical busts side by side with their heads inclined together in quiet counsel, joined by a single glowing thought-bubble rising between them.

name: Gemini Cartographer
subject: Two engraved chrome classical celestial cartographers jointly presenting one unrolled star-chart scroll, each figure with exactly two readable arms and hands, holding the scroll naturally without extra hands at its corners, constellation lines and a restrained celestial orbit behind them.

name: Open Weights Pilgrim
subject: A hooded chrome pilgrim with a walking staff trudging uphill, carrying on one shoulder a heavy open ring-shaped weight plate with light streaming through its hollow center.

name: Toolset Cartographer
subject: A chrome cartographer's unrolled map whose landmarks are tiny tools, with a hammer-shaped hill and a wrench-shaped river, and a drafting compass planted in the middle.

name: Config Surgeon
subject: A chrome scalpel and forceps hovering over a cog gear opened on an operating tray like a patient, tiny screws and springs floating above the incision.

name: Rebase Acrobat
subject: A chrome acrobat mid-backflip leaping from one branching rail line to another, trailing a ribbon that reattaches to the trunk higher up.

name: Test Suite Tamer
subject: A chrome lion sitting calmly on a pedestal with a whip curled around its paw, a chrome shield carved with a bold check-shaped notch leaning against its side.

name: Screenshot Hunter
subject: A chrome vintage bellows camera aimed straight out at the viewer, with crosshair framing brackets floating in front of it like a hunter's sight and a hunting horn on its tripod.

name: Marathon Operator
subject: A chrome marathon runner in winged sandals breaking through a finish ribbon, a gleaming engraved perspective running track receding cleanly to a glowing horizon behind.

name: Weekend Warrior
subject: A crested chrome warrior reclining in a hammock slung between two Doric columns, sword and shield propped aside, a laurel wreath tilted over his eyes.

name: Night Shift Operator
subject: A chrome owl perched on a crescent moon with wide glowing eyes, a lit lantern hanging from one talon, stars scattered around it as halftone dots.

name: Cache Hit Appreciator
subject: A veiled chrome archery target with an arrow lodged exactly in the bullseye, the target partly draped in cloth and a gem glowing at its center.

name: Forge Apprentice
subject: A small chrome apprentice in a leather apron standing on a stool beside a giant forge bellows, lifting a first newly forged wing-shaped blade with tongs.

name: Whetstone
subject: A chrome sword blade being drawn along a whetstone, a shower of sparks fanning into a radiating burst, the edge catching a bright periwinkle glint.

name: Open Book
subject: A chrome open book whose blank pages lift off by themselves and spiral upward like a flock of doves, the spine glowing softly from within.

name: Card Catalog
subject: A chrome library card-catalog cabinet of dozens of tiny drawers, one pulled wide open and spilling a fan of blank index cards across its front.

name: Arsenal Inventory
subject: A chrome hoplite shield at the center with a spear, bow, trident, sword and axe fanned out behind it in a radiating arrangement like sunrays.

name: Teach, Test, Tweak
subject: A shrouded ring of three chrome tools, a chisel, a magnifier and a wrench, chasing each other around a laurel wreath, the whole loop veiled by a thin chrome cloth.

name: Elephant Never Forgets
subject: A chrome elephant in profile with a faceted crystal gem set into its forehead, its trunk curled high and a long engraved memory-ribbon trailing from its tusk.

name: Note To Self
subject: A small chrome folded note, one corner curling, stabbed by a tiny quill and pinned to the forehead of a classical bust as a reminder.

name: Deja Vu
subject: A chrome classical bust repeated as three fading ghost echoes stepping back one behind the other, each slightly rotated, like a stuttering reflection.

name: Squeeze Play
subject: A heavy chrome bench vise squeezing a swollen sphere between its jaws, cobalt light seeping through the cracks while the sphere holds together.

name: Heavy Lifting
subject: A chrome weightlifter in a classical stance heaving a colossal barbell overhead, a mountain-sized pile of loose stone blocks tumbling away behind him.

name: Spring Cleaning
subject: A shrouded chrome broom sweeping a drift of dusty old crystals into a dustpan beneath a half-lifted cloth, a single fresh sprig sprouting from the swept floor.

name: Many Hats
subject: A tall teetering stack of chrome hats from different eras, a laurel wreath, a Phrygian cap, a winged traveler's hat, a top hat and a crown, balanced on a single bust.

name: Home Turf
subject: A square cutaway chunk of turf lifted out of the ground like a diorama, holding a tiny chrome house with a chimney and a flag planted on its roof.

name: Bot Whisperer
subject: A friendly chrome robot head with a small antenna, tilting its ear toward an unseen whisper rendered as curling hairlines that flow into its audio grille.

name: Hat Trick
subject: Three chrome crowns of rising size levitating one above the other over an open magician's top hat, three rabbit ears peeking from the brim.

name: Always On
subject: A chrome lighthouse whose beam is a wide fan of hairlines, a sleepless open eye glowing in the lantern room and signal arcs rippling out from its tip.

name: Split Personality
subject: A shrouded chrome classical head carrying five distinct faces fanned in a half-circle like a folding screen, the veil lifted from only one of them.

name: Set It And Forget It
subject: A chrome rotary egg-timer dial turned all the way and left alone on a pedestal, a pair of winged sandals walking away over a horizon behind it.

name: Clockwork
subject: A chrome open clock mechanism, a sunburst of interlocking gears around a balance wheel and swinging pendulum, every tooth catching a periwinkle glint.

name: Overnight Shift
subject: A chrome gear wheel turning under a field of dithered stars, a tiny crescent moon perched on its teeth and a thin ribbon of dawn glowing on the horizon.

name: Many Schedules
subject: A cluster of seven chrome timepieces of different kinds, a sundial, pocket watch, cuckoo clock, water clock and more, arranged like flower petals around a center with tick marks only.

name: Pause Button
subject: A pause symbol built as two chrome Doric columns, with a frozen waterfall of crystal drops hanging motionless between them.

name: Ghost In The Schedule
subject: A shrouded chrome pendulum clock beside a ghostly sheet-draped figure floating in the air, a pair of winged sandals poking out from beneath the sheet.

name: Plugin Hand
subject: A monumental upright chrome fist gripping a winged electrical connector like a ceremonial torch, on a low engraved plinth with a laurel wrist cuff. Four distinct curled fingers wrap around the front of the vertical barrel, with one naturally opposing thumb, all five digits readable. Two parallel contacts point upward, and broad swept feathered wings rise above the grip for a strong heraldic silhouette. No socket, no floating outlet, no loose drapery.

name: Bridge Builder
subject: A chrome arched suspension bridge spanning a chasm between two floating islands, its cables radiating like hairlines and a tiny messenger crossing the span.

name: Many Doors
subject: A cluster of five chrome doorways in different styles, arched, round, square, triangular and keyhole-shaped, arranged around a hub with light spilling from each.

name: Third Party
subject: A trio of chrome goblets clinking together in a toast, the third goblet a different shape and standing slightly apart, a small party cone perched on its stem.

name: Tool Collector
subject: A chrome glass-fronted display case holding nine different tools pinned in neat rows like butterflies, a small lamp lighting the collection from above.

name: Tool Spelunker
subject: A shrouded chrome miner's helmet with a lamp, its beam piercing a hanging cloth and revealing the glinting tips of buried tools in the dark rock behind.

name: Trophy Room
subject: A chrome arched alcove holding a single laurel-crowned cup on a plinth, flanked by twin torches whose light radiates in fine etched hairlines.

name: Wardrobe Change
subject: A chrome dress form dressed half in a flowing toga and half in a sleek futuristic tunic, a rack of different hangers swinging behind it.

name: Sightseer
subject: A chrome coin-operated sightseeing viewer on a post, aimed at a distant ring of tiny floating landmark temples that glow against the sky.

name: Page Turner
subject: A chrome flipbook thumbed through by a winged thumb, a single leaf caught mid-turn with ghosted afterimages of the other leaves fanned out behind it.

name: Tinkerer
subject: A shrouded chrome wind-up toy robot on a workbench holding a tiny screwdriver, half covered by a cloth, one exposed gear spinning in its chest.

name: Trophy Hunter
subject: A chrome trophy cup mounted like a hunter's prize on a shield-shaped plaque, its two handles branching into stag antlers.

name: Everywhere At Once
subject: A many-armed chrome classical statue, each arm holding a different device, a handheld phone, laptop, radio, tablet and console, arranged in a radiating halo.

name: Telegram Regular
subject: A chrome vintage telegraph machine with a ribbon of punched tape curling out in a spiral, a small winged messenger perched on the key.

name: Discord Dweller
subject: A chrome hermit crab living inside a spiral conch shell shaped like a chat bubble, glowing windows lit in its whorls, antennae raised.

name: Group Chat Goblin
subject: A grinning chrome goblin atop a pile of overlapping speech bubbles, juggling little heart tokens and bells while more bubbles pop around it.

name: Terminal Native
subject: A chrome laurel-crowned bust with a single solid rectangular cursor block glowing on its forehead, a bare keyboard of blank keys carved into its pedestal.

name: Smoke Signals
subject: A small chrome brazier on a cliff releasing a column of smoke shaped into three distinct puffs, a thin veil of cloth drifting across the flame.

name: Task Force
subject: A phalanx of interlocking chrome shields forming a wedge arrowhead, spear tips bristling forward from behind them in a disciplined radiating line.

name: Clocked In
subject: A chrome industrial punch-clock with a card half inserted and the stamping arm striking down, a small winged cap hanging from a hook beside it.

name: Roadblock
subject: A chrome road barricade of crossed striped beams blocking a path, with a messenger's winged sandals leaping over it in mid-hop.

name: Hive Mind
subject: A chrome skep beehive wreathed by a swarm of small winged bees flying in one coordinated spiral, hexagonal cells glowing in its flank.

name: Org Chart
subject: A chrome tree-shaped hierarchy, a classical bust at the crown branching downward through connected nodes into rows of smaller and smaller busts.

name: Peer Review
subject: A veiled chrome pair of spectacles resting on a returned sheaf of blank pages, one lens clear and the other covered by a thin cloth, a quill poised between them.

name: Ghost In The Browser
subject: A sheeted chrome ghost floating behind a mouse-cursor arrow, holding it aloft like a toy, its hem trailing away in fine etched hairlines.

name: Tab Hoarder
subject: A chrome squirrel hugging an enormous armful of index-tabbed folder dividers fanned into an overflowing stack, cheeks stuffed and tail curled high.

name: Dev Tools Devotee
subject: A chrome acolyte kneeling before a small altar cut open to reveal gears and tubes inside, holding a magnifier and a wrench up like holy relics.

name: Dialog Dodger
subject: A chrome dancer twisting aside as a flurry of flat rectangular pop-up cards flies past, one card slicing through the edge of the dancer's flowing cloak.

name: Eagle Eye
subject: A chrome eagle's head in profile with one huge keen eye, fine radiating sight-lines etched across the frame, a laurel sprig clasped in its beak.

name: Vault Opener
subject: A shrouded round chrome vault door with a spoked wheel, the door ajar a crack with cobalt light spilling out, a draped cloth hanging over the wheel.

name: Director's Cut
subject: A chrome vintage film camera with two large reels, a snipped ribbon of film curling down from it and a pair of scissors poised at the cut.

name: Gallery Owner
subject: A chrome easel holding a canvas of cobalt dithered hills, flanked by a pair of velvet-rope stanchions and lit by a single overhead spotlight.

name: Radio Voice
subject: A chrome vintage ribbon microphone with a broadcast antenna arc above it and concentric sound waves radiating outward in fine etched hairlines.

name: Studio Session
subject: A chrome folding director's chair buried under a tumbling pile of canvases, film reels and a camera, a star-shaped spotlight glaring down from overhead.

name: Multimedia Mage
subject: A chrome wizard's staff crowned by three orbiting orbs, one carved as a camera-lens eye, one as a film reel and one as a sound-wave speaker cone.

name: Auteur
subject: A shrouded tower of film reels and stacked canvases crowned with a laurel wreath, a thin chrome cloth veil draped across its upper half and a small viewfinder lens perched on top.
